market_pulse.note: Near $63,000 around 12:30 p.m. ET Thursday, down about 0.4% over 24 hours, after peaking at $64,005 and dipping close to $62,300; CoinDesk logged $62,250 at 12:19 p.m. ET (Bitcoin.com News; CoinDesk).
About $1,776, up 0.47% on CoinDesk's ticker midday Thursday, after trading near $1,800 early in the day (CoinDesk).
About $2.14 trillion, down 1.01% over 24 hours, as of 16:00 UTC (11 a.m. ET) Thursday (The Daily Coins).
About 58.7% as of 16:00 UTC Thursday; CoinGecko data cited by Cryptonomist showed 58.93% earlier in the day (The Daily Coins; Cryptonomist).

themes.title: Anthropic debut fails to lift crypto
themes.summary: Bitcoin slipped through the morning even as Anthropic opened 34% above its IPO price, with CoinDesk noting the strong opening failed to lift risk appetite in crypto (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Seventh weekly loss in view
themes.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a seventh straight weekly decline, its second-longest losing streak, and trades more than 7% below its 200-week moving average (CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen about $2.9 billion of net outflows so far in November (Cryptonomist; CoinDesk).

themes.title: Fed and weak data weigh
themes.summary: Fed minutes showed some officials open to a hike larger than a quarter point; the Philly Fed index fell to 6.3 and jobless claims rose to 203,000 (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index sits at 10, versus 11 a day earlier and 28 a week ago; about $350 million of crypto positions were liquidated, mostly longs (The Daily Coins; Bitcoin.com News).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin near $63,000 and Ether near $1,776 midday; Bitcoin is down about 13.8% and Ether about 12.3% over seven days (CoinDesk; The Daily Coins).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: XRP traded near $0.97 and Solana near $74; Hyperliquid's HYPE rose about 2.7% to $68.57 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: Mixed: ether.fi gained about 11% over 24 hours while Curve DAO Token fell about 4.3% (The Daily Coins).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoin supply stood at about $286.4 billion (The Daily Coins).

watch_list.why: The level marked the overnight low and the floor for weeks 40 through 46, while $64,000 has capped recent rebounds (CoinDesk; Bitcoin.com News).
LayerZero (ZRO) and KAITO token unlocks and Japan's October CPI are scheduled for Nov. 20 (KuCoin).
Markets price a December rate increase as highly likely, a backdrop that has weighed on crypto (CoinDesk; KuCoin).
